assets.title: Прямой прилавок
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: individual transparent PNG reference for image-to-3D reconstruction of a merchant stall for our stylized fantasy action RPG camp.
Primary request: Generate exactly ONE complete assembled wooden merchant stall, one object in one image, ready as a clean Tripo reconstruction reference. This is a standalone asset, not a scene, collage, sheet, exploded view or diagram.
Style: stylized three-dimensional game environment prop, hand-painted matte materials, chunky rounded timber beams, mildly irregular broad planks, bevelled edges, large readable forms, broad painted wood grain and restrained wear. Match a painterly isometric forest camp with sturdy timber construction and simple cloth structures. The finish is polished game art with moderate geometric detail, not photorealism and not flat cartoon drawing; no thick black outlines. A lived-in travelling trader's stall rather than a fancy permanent shop.
Palette: weathered warm medium brown and ochre wood, faded muted olive-green canvas, oatmeal burlap, subdued brown leather, simple dull iron fasteners. Canvas has plain seams and several broad natural folds, no markings or patterns.
Subject details: wooden counter, fabric canopy, shelves, a few clearly separated groups of goods arranged at low, counter and shelf heights: substantial wooden crates, coarse tied bundles, rolled cloth, small leather packages, plain earthenware containers. Leave some empty counter surface and the trader's standing space open. Goods rest on believable shelves and ledges. Avoid tiny dense clutter. The base/counter, structural canopy and groups of goods must have clean visible boundaries for later modular 3D modelling; everything is assembled and attached, no floating parts.
Proportions: approximately 5.2 metres wide by 3.8 metres deep, canopy about 2.7 metres high. Keep a broad, low camp silhouette, not a tall narrow kiosk. Do not write measurements.
Camera/framing: one elevated front three-quarter view, modest orthographic-like perspective, around 25 degrees above horizontal. The front counter face, one side, the shelf contents and canopy top must all read clearly. Entire object centred with generous transparent margin; all roof corners, posts and feet visible, no cropping. High-resolution square composition.
Background: genuine fully transparent alpha around the entire isolated object and through all open gaps. No opaque background, no baked checkerboard, no gradient, no horizon, no environment, no ground plane, no floor slab, no platform or pedestal.
Lighting: unlit-style diffuse/albedo asset presentation with even neutral colour visibility and only very gentle form shading. No directional lighting, no sunset tint, no bright highlights, no dramatic contrast, no baked cast shadows or shadow beneath the object. No visible light sources.
Absolutely exclude: flags, pennants, banners, heraldry, coats of arms, crests, shields, emblems, symbols, runes, logos, signs, text, watermarks, striped canopy, decorative triangular trim, people, animals, weapons, lanterns, lamps, candles, torches, fire, glow, smoke, plants, scenery.

Architecture for this variant: a classic rectangular stall with FOUR thick square wooden posts, a single simple lean-to canopy sloping gently down toward the customer, straight canvas front edge and a straight plank-fronted wide counter. One long rear shelf and one short side shelving unit are attached to the same body. Rectangular silhouette, sturdy uncomplicated joints, open sides. Three modest clusters of goods at different heights. The canopy is one plain faded olive cloth stretched over straight beams.
